Reservations

10% cheaper than the booking websites

Booking directly with us is cheaper than the big booking websites, and it is the only way to ask for one of the specific rooms you have fallen for. Choose your dates below.

Our booking system lets you reserve the corresponding category of room. If you want to be allocated in one specific room, write its name in the "Comment" section of the booking form.
Check-in is guaranteed from 2pm. You are welcome to arrive earlier and relax with us, but your room may not be ready yet.

A question before you book? Write to us.

Email us your dates WhatsApp us Call +62 8810 370 928 55
